requirements.text: The platform shall support at least 100 concurrent users during initial pilot deployments, with a target of 1,000 concurrent users after 2 years of consolidation.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder expects growth from a few pilot municipalities to many, referencing VicomSaga's many users and exponential growth after consolidation.

requirements.text: The platform shall allow institutions to install the software on their own servers, with a documented installation process requiring no more than 4 hours for a system administrator.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder emphasized autonomy and the ability to install on own servers, which implies a reasonable setup time for adopters.

requirements.text: The platform shall support the attachment of media files (photos, videos, audio) to geographic data records, with a maximum file size of 20 MB per attachment.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly confirmed support for photo, film, and audio attachments; file size limit is inferred from common mobile data collection constraints.

requirements.text: The platform shall be stable and free of critical bugs before mass release, with a beta testing phase involving at least two pilot municipalities (e.g., Barra and Moçambique) for 4-6 months.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated the ideal is to release only after pilot consolidation and bug-free stability, with a 4-6 month timeline for Barra.

requirements.text: The platform shall have a user-friendly and accessible interface for non-technical users, so that the general population can easily capture and view geographic data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated that Mais Lugar should focus on 'capturing in a more friendly way' for the population, contrasting with more technical tools.

requirements.text: The platform shall load and display geographic map layers within 3 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load.
requirements.rationale: The platform is centered on geographic data visualization; users expect responsive map interactions, and comparable platforms (e.g., VicomSaga) imply a performance baseline.

requirements.text: The platform shall be available in Portuguese (Brazilian) and potentially other languages, so that users can use the platform in their native language.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned expansion to Mozambique (Portuguese-speaking) and other countries, implying the need for localization beyond Brazilian Portuguese.

requirements.text: The platform shall be available as a web application accessible via standard web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and as a mobile application supporting offline data collection.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated access via web and mobile, with offline capability for field data collection, modeled after ODK.

requirements.text: The mobile application shall support offline data collection with automatic synchronization when connectivity is restored, with a maximum synchronization delay of 30 seconds after reconnection.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly described offline data capture and automatic upload upon reconnection, referencing ODK's performance.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to support a trail/route tracking feature, so that I can record paths taken during field work.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned 'marcação de trilha' as a secondary but useful functionality.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the platform to support single sign-on (SSO) integration with the VicomSaga platform, so that I can seamlessly access both systems without re-entering credentials.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned that users should use the same password and login to move between MaisLugar and VicomSaga.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to support import and export of vector data (points, lines, polygons), so that I can exchange geographic data with other systems.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned import/export of vectors and later export formats like CSV, XLS, HTML.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the platform to integrate with Vicom Saga via a plugin, so that users can seamlessly transfer geospatial layers between the two systems without manual export/import.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder repeatedly expresses the desire for a direct plugin integration with Vicom Saga to avoid reinventing the wheel and to maintain collaboration with that existing system.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to view geographic layers on a web map, with access controlled by user role (public vs. restricted), so that I can see relevant territorial data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described web map visualization with layer access control per user role.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the platform to support offline data collection on mobile devices, so that users can capture georeferenced data in the field without internet access and sync later.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder confirms the need for offline data collection on mobile, referencing ODK as an example, and describes automatic upload upon connection.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the platform to provide a plugin architecture for integration with external systems like Vicom Saga and QGIS, so that the system can be extended without modifying core code.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly uses the term 'plugin' to describe the desired integration mechanism for Vicom Saga and QGIS.

requirements.text: The platform shall provide an open-source license for at least the core codebase, allowing institutions to modify and customize the software.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated the code should be free and open for institutions to program and adapt.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to store user registration data including email, username, and password, so that I can authenticate and access the platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated that for user registration, only email, username, and password are needed.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to define access permissions for different user roles (viewer, editor, manager) per project, so that I can control who can view, edit, or delete project data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described roles (viewer, editor, manager) and permissions per project, similar to existing systems.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to invite users and assign roles within a project, so that role assignment is managed at project level.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder said 'the invitation' when asked how roles are assigned, implying invitation-based role assignment.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to store geographic data as points, lines, and polygons, so that I can represent territorial features.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder listed 'creation of point, line, polygon' as essential functionalities.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to create customizable questionnaires/forms with various variable types, so that data collection can be tailored to each project.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder repeatedly emphasized creating questionnaires/forms as a core feature, similar to VicomSaga.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to collect data offline (fill forms, mark points) and synchronize automatically when connected, so that I can work in the field without internet.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentioned offline data collection and automatic sync, citing ODK as a reference.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to automatically record metadata (timestamp, user who made the record) for each data entry, so that data provenance is tracked.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned automatic recording of time and user metadata.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to allow attachment of media files (photos, videos, audio) to collected data, so that rich contextual information can be stored.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder confirmed support for photo, filming, and audio data.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to support export of data in CSV, XLS, and HTML formats, so that data can be used in external analysis tools.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder listed CSV, XLS, HTML as export formats.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to allow export of selected layers rather than all data, so that I can control what is exported.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder said 'decide the layers that will be exported' when asked about export organization.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to store user gamification data (medals, avatar progression, levels like 'Master' and 'Pleno') at platform level across projects, so that user participation is incentivized collaboratively.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described a gamification system with medals, avatar, and user levels that accumulate across projects.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to configure which layers are visible to the general public and which are restricted to specific roles, so that I can protect confidential data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentioned setting layer visibility for public vs. managers/researchers.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to allow import of shapefiles (SHP) from QGIS, so that pre-processed geographic data can be brought into the platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned importing SHP layers from QGIS.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to support trail/route tracking as a secondary feature, so that I can record field paths.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned 'trail marking' as a non-priority but useful functionality.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to allow external embedding of project maps as images or web maps via a shareable link, so that institutions can display results on their own websites.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described institutions wanting to show work via image or web map and copying a link to embed, implying this feature.

requirements.text: The platform must support the option for institutions to install the platform on their own servers, so that they have full autonomy and control over their data and projects.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder expressed a desire for institutions to be able to install the program on their own servers, ensuring autonomy.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to create, edit, import, and export geographic vector data (points, lines, polygons) within a project, so that I can represent territorial features for health planning.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly listed creation, import, export, and editing of vectors as essential functionalities.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to register with email, username, and password, so that I can access the platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specified the minimal registration data: email, username, and password.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to invite users to a project with specific roles (viewer, editor, manager), so that I can control who can view, edit, or delete project data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder compared this to the VicomSaga system, where roles like viewer, editor, and manager are assigned via invitation.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to attach media files (photos, videos, audio) to collected data, so that I can enrich field observations.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder confirmed support for photo, video, and audio attachments.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to export project data in CSV, XLS, and HTML formats, selecting specific layers, so that I can use the data in other tools.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specified export formats (CSV, XLS, HTML) and the ability to choose layers.

requirements.text: As a user, I want a gamification system where I earn medals and level up (e.g., from beginner to master) by contributing to projects, so that I am motivated to participate collaboratively.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described a non-competitive gamification with medals, avatars, and user levels based on contributions.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to integrate the platform with existing systems (e.g., VicomSaga, QGIS) via plugins or direct export/import, so that I can reuse existing tools and avoid reinventing functionality.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder strongly emphasized integration with VicomSaga and QGIS via plugins or direct data exchange.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to import pre-filtered layers from VicomSaga or QGIS into the platform, so that I can visualize and share processed geospatial data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described importing filtered layers from VicomSaga as a priority feature.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to access the platform via web and mobile (with offline capability), so that I can use it in diverse field conditions.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated access via web and mobile, with mobile mainly for offline data collection.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the platform to import shapefile (SHP) layers from QGIS, so that data processed in QGIS can be used within Mais Lugar.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentions the need for Mais Lugar to import SHP layers from QGIS, indicating a data exchange requirement with that tool.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to export project data in CSV, XLS, and HTML formats, so that I can analyze the data in other tools or share it with external stakeholders.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly listed CSV, XLS, and HTML as desired export formats.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to select specific layers before exporting, so that I can control which data is included in the exported file.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated that the export should allow choosing which layers to include, with further data cleaning done externally.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the system to automatically capture metadata such as timestamp and user ID when data is recorded, so that the data origin and timing are traceable.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly mentioned that the system should automatically record the time and the user who made the registration.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want the platform to offer public API endpoints for embedding project data (e.g., web maps) into external websites, so that project results can be shared transparently with the public.
requirements.rationale: The need to copy a link and embed it in a website implies the platform must expose a public API or embeddable widget for that purpose.

requirements.text: The platform shall allow a user to register with only an email, username, and password, completing the process in under 2 minutes.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder said 'as fast as possible' and specified only email, username, and password for registration, implying a quick, minimal process.

requirements.text: The platform shall enforce role-based access control with at least three roles per project: manager (can delete project), editor (can edit data), and viewer (can only view data).
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly described these three roles and their permissions, modeled after VicomSaga.

requirements.text: The platform shall automatically record metadata for each data entry, including timestamp and the user who made the record.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated automatic recording of time and user metadata for each record.

requirements.text: The platform shall support a gamification system that tracks user contributions across projects, awarding badges and leveling up (e.g., from 'Popular' to 'Master' user) without competition.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly described a cooperative gamification system with badges, avatars, and user levels based on contributions.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to create geographic features (points, lines, polygons) and import/export them in standard GIS formats (e.g., Shapefile), so that I can work with geographic data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder listed creation of point, line, polygon, import/export, and editing of these vectors, plus Shapefile import from QGIS.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to perform user authentication via secure login (email/username and password), so that only registered users can access the platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder specified that users register with email, username, and password, implying authentication is required.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to define which imported data layers are visible to which user groups (e.g., general public, technical users, scientists), so that data access is controlled per layer.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder stated that within MaisLugar, the manager should decide which layers are for the general public, for technical users, or for scientists.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to provide a public-facing web map and embeddable links for projects, so that the general public can view non-confidential data without requiring a login.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned that prefectures should be able to copy a link to embed a project's web map on their own site, implying public access without authentication.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to log all user actions (e.g., data entry, edits, exports) with timestamp and user ID, so that an audit trail is maintained for security and compliance.
requirements.rationale: The explicit requirement for metadata (timestamp and user) for each record implies the need for a broader audit trail of user actions.

requirements.text: The platform shall be accessible via web and mobile devices, so that users can participate in data collection and visualization from anywhere.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated the platform should be accessible on web and mobile, including offline data collection.

requirements.text: As a field worker, I want to collect data offline on a mobile device, so that I can record geographic information and questionnaires even without internet connectivity.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned the need for offline data collection on mobile, similar to the ODK tool.

requirements.text: As a field worker, I want to automatically synchronize collected data when the device reconnects to the internet, so that my contributions are uploaded without manual intervention.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder confirmed that data saved offline should be automatically uploaded when connectivity is restored.

requirements.text: The platform shall allow a user to register with only email, username, and password, completing the process quickly, so that I can start using the platform with minimal friction.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated that registration should be as fast as possible, requiring only email, username, and password.

requirements.text: As a general user, I want to view public map layers, so that I can access non-confidential geographic information shared by institutions.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described that general users can view certain public layers, while confidential data remains restricted.

requirements.text: The platform shall provide a gamification system that rewards collective contributions with medals and avatar progression, so that I feel motivated to participate in data collection and community engagement.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described a non-competitive gamification system where users earn medals and grow their avatar by contributing, fostering collective growth.

requirements.text: As a user, I want to see my gamification progress (medals, avatar, XP) across all projects I participate in, so that my overall contribution to the platform is recognized.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder indicated that user progression (e.g., becoming a 'Master' or 'pleno' user) should be cross-project and platform-wide.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to embed the platform's web map into my institution's website via a link, so that the public can view project results directly on our site.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder expressed the desire for institutions to copy a link and embed the web map into their own websites, providing autonomy.

requirements.text: The platform shall provide access to the source code (free/libre), so that developers or institutions can customize the platform to meet their specific needs.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder emphasized the importance of free/libre access to the code, allowing institutions to program and tailor the platform.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to integrate Mais Lugar with VicomSaga via a plugin, so that I can seamlessly transfer layers between the two systems without reinventing existing functionality.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder repeatedly expressed a strong desire for a plugin that allows automatic import/export of layers between VicomSaga and Mais Lugar.

requirements.text: As a field worker, I want to attach photos, videos, and audio files to my collected geographic data, so that I can provide richer context for the observations.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder confirmed that the system should support attaching photo, video, and audio files to collected data.

requirements.text: As a project manager, I want to be able to delete a project entirely, so that I can remove outdated or incorrect initiatives from the platform.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder described the manager role as having the ability to delete a project, similar to VicomSaga.

requirements.text: As a user, I want the system to support creating points, lines, and polygons on the map, so that I can represent geographic features accurately.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder listed creation of points, lines, and polygons as essential functionalities.

requirements.text: The platform shall be available within 4 to 6 months for a pilot in Barra municipality, so that the project can be demonstrated with real data.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder expressed a concrete timeline expectation for a pilot deployment in Barra.
